# ASTR3

> MIT TypeScript library for explorable Western astrology wheels with Three.js.
> Browser rendering, headless models, optional local ephemeris, natal and transit charts.
> Version 0.1.1 is experimental. Prebuilt tarballs, browser ZIPs and an installable WordPress plugin are available through the website build; the npm package name is @yuzuwoeser/astr3.

## Integration

- [Installation](docs/installation.md): scoped npm installation and prebuilt browser/WordPress downloads, release checksums and complete starters.
- [Coverage roadmap](docs/integration-roadmap.md): phased framework, backend and CMS expansion; future stacks are not yet supported.

- [Getting started](README.md): prebuilt installation, a mounted chart example, capabilities and local website/playground.
- [Framework and website integrations](docs/integrations.md): example registry, live guides, browser download, WordPress plugin, PHP and Rails recipes.
- [Selection demonstration](https://yuzuwoeser.github.io/astr3/examples/selection/): invented natal/transit data, relationship highlighting and an application-owned panel.
- [Clickable React chart](https://yuzuwoeser.github.io/astr3/integrations/react/): runnable starter and tutorial for selection events, updates and Strict Mode cleanup.
- [Agent integration](docs/agent-integration.md): entry-point selection, headless example, browser lifecycle and common mistakes.
- [API contracts](docs/api.md): entry points and exported types, normalized models, math/selection helpers, renderer options, events, SVG/PNG export, accessibility and calculation signatures.
- [JSON templates](docs/api.md#json-templates): versioned natal/transit appearance presets, resolver types/errors, defaults, shallow overrides and the packaged schema.
- [Template schema](chart-template.schema.json): strict JSON Schema draft 2020-12 for both template variants; exported as astr3/chart-template.schema.json.
- [Runnable template example](https://yuzuwoeser.github.io/astr3/examples/json-templates/): live natal/transit previews, downloadable JSON and actual source.
- [Transit API](docs/transits.md): a working wheel example, composite models and helpers, source-qualified selections, renderer/animation events and demo controls.
- [Calculation conventions](docs/calculations.md): coordinate conventions, houses, nodes and measured accuracy limits.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): model/provider/application boundaries, shared drawing/export, packing, typography, conjunction geometry and animation sampling.

## Contributing

- [GitHub Pages website](docs/github-pages.md): production build/preview, smoke tests, automatic deployment and recovery.
- [Repository agent instructions](AGENTS.md): source map, invariants, checks and local commits.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): reproducible setup and review workflow.
- [Release checklist](docs/releasing.md): history, privacy, builds and packed artifacts.
- [Security reporting](SECURITY.md): private reporting policy and data handling.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): current capabilities and upcoming changes.
